decisions: Select the existing exact Tensor W route after real CUDA parity and representative timing; recompile and rerun hardware parity before canonical use.
Keep original MAC, NoPeek, fresh one-time correlations and real AES PCG; no correlation reuse.
The 256 MiB runtime allowance is not demonstrated: tiny CUDA diagnostics already observe roughly 550 MB whole-device usage; preserve canonical physical stop without relaxing or excluding it.

environment.measurement_caveat: CPU preparation and reduced CPU tests overlapped some component diagnostics; each GPU diagnostic used the same single H100 without another GPU workload. Whole-GPU samples can include context memory outside a CPU test tree.
